inputs.name: fixed point (commit, branch, tag, merge-base)
inputs.source: user or the pull request base

inputs.name: spec, issue or pull request description
inputs.source: repository forge via the host's GitHub tools, or a file the user names

inputs.name: standards
inputs.source: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, ADRs, linked organization standards

outputs.name: review report
outputs.format: markdown: ## Standards and ## Spec sections reported side by side, one-line summary, checks run

runtime.name: git
runtime.purpose: diff and log against the fixed point

conditions: Changes go through the repository's pull request review; the skill never merges or deploys.
